newsitem.title: INDIA: SOCCER-IRAQ RETAIN NEHRU GOLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IRAQ RETAIN NEHRU GOLD CUP.

text.p: Holders Iraq beat Asian Games gold medallists Uzbekistan 3-1 in the final of the Nehru Gold Cup soccer tournament on Saturday.
Striker Husam Naji, who scored the winner in Iraq's 1-0 victory over Russia in last year's final in Calcutta, gave them the lead in the fifth minute after dribbling past three defenders.
Uzbek defender Anatoly Kuralev put the ball into his own goal when trying to intercept a corner from Laith Hussain Shihab in the 20th minute to give Iraq a two-goal lead.
Ravashanjon Mataliev pulled one back in the 43rd minute.
Shihab, judged player of the final, sealed Iraq's victory with a great goal on the hour.
